messages:
Arman: quick FYI — noticed handbook/guides/runtime-quickstart.md has a broken image (screenshot-alloc.png) returning 403 on staging. no owner in frontmatter. who can pick this up?
Keeley: I can look. do you have the staging console output?
Arman: console shows `GET /assets/docs/screenshots/screenshot-alloc.png 403` and the page render shows a broken image icon. appears to be an S3 permission rehost issue.
docops-bot: scan: missing-owner detected for handbook/guides/runtime-quickstart.md (rule=docs.owner-required). asset 403 flagged: /assets/docs/screenshots/screenshot-alloc.png (id=8812). recommended: rehost asset under /assets/handbook/ and add owner frontmatter.
Keeley: plan: 1) re-upload the screenshot to /assets/handbook/screenshots/screenshot-alloc.png with public-read, 2) update markdown reference, 3) add frontmatter owner: @Keeley, 4) open PR with changelog note.
Nisha: tiny ask: please keep filename stable and add alt text `alt="runtime allocation screenshot"` — accessibility test fails on missing alt.
Keeley: good catch. will add alt. sed snippet I'll use to add frontmatter: `sed -i '1s/^/owner: @Keeley\n/' handbook/guides/runtime-quickstart.md`
Arman: if you rehost keep the original image dimensions or the layout will shift in the quickstart. prefer compressed PNG under 200KB.
Keeley: compressing with `pngquant --quality=65-80` before upload. PR will replace path and include alt.
QA-bot: presubmit-check: image-alt missing check will run on PR. also runs asset-size warning (>200KB).
Keeley: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/14141 title: "rehost runtime screenshot + add owner + alt"  requesting @Nisha for quick accessibility review.
Nisha: reviewing now, left 1 tiny nit about alt wording — prefer "Runtime allocation UI (example)". also checked compressed PNG looks fine.
Keeley: pushed alt wording fix. CI green. merging on green.
Arman: merged, thanks! left a short note in #eng-announce about the quickstart image fix. docs-bot: changelog: handbook/guides/runtime-quickstart.md owner=@Keeley asset 8812 rehosted.
Keeley: reminder: if you hit staging image 403s, please include the asset path + console snippet here so we can triage quickly.
